title: Brand Alignment Checker
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners rate a story draft as aligned, neutral, or misaligned with four brand attributes, explain their reasoning, and compare it with an expert analysis and an on-brand rewrite.

learningObjectives: Evaluate a story against brand attributes (innovation, reliability, customer focus, technical excellence) and identify alignment or misalignment.
prerequisites: Story Brand Alignment and Brand Voice Consistency sections of Chapter 13

keyQuestions: Evaluate a story against brand attributes (innovation, reliability, customer focus, technical excellence) and identify alignment or misalignment.
assessmentOpportunities: Ratings match the expert on all four attributes.
Explanations cite specific words in the draft.
